description: You are a data analyst investigating survival patterns from the Titanic disaster using the TitanicSurvival.csv dataset loaded in jamovi. The dataset contains records for approximately 1,309 passengers with variables: 'survived' (yes/no), 'sex' (female/male), 'age' (years), and 'passengerClass' (1st/2nd/3rd). Your task is to examine whether survival was associated with passenger class and sex using chi-square tests of independence. Run two separate analyses: (1) a chi-square test examining the association between 'survived' and 'passengerClass', and (2) a chi-square test examining the association between 'survived' and 'sex'. For both analyses, include expected counts and row percentages in the contingency tables so the survival rates can be compared across groups. Save the completed analysis as /home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/TitanicAnalysis.omv.
